blocks.content: Course: API Handling with Asynchronous Javascript
We'll fetch job listings from Remotive, a real remote job board API. Our fetchJobs() function will:

items: Build the URL safely using encodeURIComponent() so special characters don't break the request
Use async/await to handle the asynchronous fetch operation
Parse the JSON response and return the jobs array
Wrap everything in a try...catch block to handle any errors that occur

blocks.content: This function handles the core workflow: build the URL, fetch the data, parse the response, and return the jobs.
Let's focus a bit more on the process of building the URL before moving on to the next step.
